description:

title: Nuss Collection Fall Museum Open House – Rochester, MN
description:
Join us for The Nuss Collection 2026 Open House, an homage to the essence of American craftsmanship and ingenuity. Step into a captivating journey through time as we showcase meticulously restored and preserved historical trucks, each representing the backbone of America’s growth and development.

Date: September 19, 2026
Time: 9 a.m. – 3 p.m.

Experience the evolution of trucking, from the early 1900s to today, with a remarkable lineup of vehicles that shaped the nation. This year’s event will honor 125 years of Mack Trucks, celebrating more than a century of groundbreaking design and innovation. Discover the fascinating stories behind these iconic machines and their enduring impact on American history.

Adding to the celebration, immerse yourself in the work of renowned artist Bob Evans, whose decades-long collaboration with Mack Trucks brought their heritage to life. His extraordinary acrylic paintings—featured in Mack calendar art and Christmas cards—will be on display, offering a unique visual tribute to Mack’s legacy.

Admission is free, and all are welcome to enjoy a day filled with history, incredible trucks, and delicious food and refreshments. Be part of this celebration of American heritage and innovation at The Nuss Collection 2026 Open House!

title: Children & Family Weekend: Loft Poetry Workshop/youth
description:
FOR THE LOVE OF THE GAME
poetry workshop, ages 13-17

"With a bolt of lightning on my kicks . . .The court is SIZZLING. My sweat is DRIZZLING. Stop all that quivering. Cuz tonight I’m delivering,"

-The Crossover, Kwame Alexander 2015

Whether you're racing down the soccer pitch, nailing a dance solo, or hitting that field goal with a swish, there's something so special about killing it at the activities you love.

But how can we put words to that exceptional feeling? How can we share with others what it means to be in that moment, with adrenaline rushing and muscle memory carrying you to success?

This class is designed especially for young people aged 13 - 17 to express their love of the game in fun, genuine ways that match the energy they feel in their favorite sport or activity. Join author and educator Dralandra Larkins at Hope Arts Center from 2 - 3:30 p.m. for a class you won't forget!

About the educator:

Dralandra Larkins is an award-winning educator, spoken-word poet, and author of Before I Lie. She serves as Lead Poetry Mentor for the Minnesota Humanities Center’s Minnesota Youth Poet Laureate program, Artistic Director for the Minnesota Black Authors Expo Executive Committee, and a COMPAS teaching artist. A recipient of the Loft Literary Center Teaching Artist Fellowship, her work has been presented by the Minneapolis Institute of Art, NAACP, Minnesota State Capitol, St. Cloud State University, and Hennepin County Library, and featured by Minnesota Public Radio,

Field Training Officers (FTOs) serve in one of the most critical roles of any organization. Beyond training new or lateral officers, they are key in building organizational culture.
